FS007帝国天骄
“慢着！”
人群外，四个大战师护着一个年轻男子从这边走来。四周挡路的人，纷纷被四个大战师撞开。
战士系职业等级和魔法师差不多，同样分战士学徒，初级战士，中级战士，高级战士，大战师，史诗战将，传说战将，圣灵战将，神话战神九个等级。
年轻男子一脸骄横，身上的魔法袍精致而考究，强烈的魔法波动能让不懂魔法的人感受到魔法的威严。
手上握着一根纯白色的法杖，法杖散发着强烈的光明系魔法波动。
“这颗紫色晶石，我要了！”年轻人趾高气昂，一副天下第一的样子。
拉尔夫为难的看了年轻男子一眼，“这位尊贵的魔法师大人，那颗晶石我已经卖给另一位尊贵的魔法师大人了，如果您想要，不妨和那位魔法师大人商量商量？”
正所谓神仙打架，凡人遭殃。一方带着七级魔兽当坐骑，一方带着四个大战师当保镖，两边都不好惹啊！
他拉尔夫，一个小小的初位高级魔法师，当真是左右不敢得罪，只能将问题推给文森。他说完之后，就哀求的看向文森，希望文森不要介意。
‘你们大人物之间的较量，可不要牵扯我啊！’拉尔夫心中暗自祈祷的时候，又疑惑起来，一颗紫晶之心而已，虽然对他们这些小人物来说是宝物，不过对于那些大人物来说，和路边的石头，又有什么区别呢？
文森笑了笑，“收拾摊位走吧，这里没你的事情了。”
“谢谢！谢谢！”拉尔夫收起七级魔法卷轴，连摊位上其他东西也不收拾，带上两个兄弟就匆匆离开。
“哼！”那个骄横的年轻人并不理会三人的离开，他狠狠的瞪了文森一眼，“小子，把那紫晶之心交出来！”
文森拿着紫菱精髓抛了抛，嗤笑道：“你是傻叉么？大家明人不说暗话，何必说这是紫晶之心呢？”
年轻人脸色一边，眼中厉芒闪烁，“你知道了什么？”
“你猜呢？”文森俏皮的眨了眨眼。
“小子，你是谁？”年轻人对四个大战师打了一个眼色，那四个大战师立马开始驱赶起围观的人群。
文森也不理会那四个大战师的行为，“小子，你知不知道，你很不礼貌！问别人之前，你该介绍你自己！”
“你！”年轻人伸出食指指着文森，咬牙切齿道：“我，德克兰－欧米茄，亚德瑞帝国子爵，帝都最年轻的高级魔法师，欧米茄公爵世家第二顺位继承人，光明教廷见习教士！那么，你又是什么人？”

一长串的名头，听起来相当的唬人，足以说明这个家伙的地位，的确是各种二代啊！
文森眉头微微皱起，随即有自嘲的笑了笑，这个家伙再牛逼又怎么样，那块紫菱精髓，他必须得到！
“文森－奥古斯丁，没有你那么一长串的后缀！”文森嘲讽道。
“哼！”德克兰－欧米茄心中暗自将帝国内各大家族理了一遍，发现并没有姓奥古斯丁的大贵族，又想了想大陆上知名大家族中也没有奥古斯丁家族，顿时底气大增。
“小子，现在给你一个机会，只要你交出那紫色晶体，我就放你一马！”德克兰牛鼻哄哄的胡吹大气道。
文森又抛了抛紫色晶体，歪着头看了他一眼，“如果我选择不呢？”
“小子，别太嚣张！惹火我，你就见不到明天的太阳了！”德克兰恶狠狠道。
阿莱格拉从三个中年人丢弃的摊位中捡起那两块银中带红的矿石，笑嘻嘻道：“德克兰，你好威风啊！”
“呃阿莱格拉，你怎么在这里？”德克兰气势顿时一弱。
阿莱格拉昂着光洁的下巴，如同骄傲的小公主一般道：“我怎么不能在这里？”
“那个呵呵”德克兰转瞬问道：“阿莱格拉，你又瞒着伯父偷跑出来的吗？”
“哼哼~”阿莱格拉不满的哼哼道：“怎么可能！人家跟着法师先生出来玩呢！”说着，阿莱格拉可怜兮兮的拉了拉文森的魔法袍。
‘这个小魔女！’文森心中感叹，随后道：“嗯，阿莱格拉跟我出来玩，德隆城主知道。”
“伯父知道？”德克兰脸色猛地一变，一股强烈的杀意涌现。
‘哼！这个小子，我迟早让你好看！吗的，不但抢走了紫菱精髓，还想泡阿莱格拉？整个亚德瑞帝国谁人不知道阿莱格拉是我德克兰的未婚妻！吗的，改天弄死你！’
感受到这股杀意，文森心中也暗暗警惕，这个世界的家族力量，他目前还不清楚。但小心为妙啊！
“我父亲当然知道啊！对了，德克兰，法师先生可是我的救命恩人，你对他客气点！不然，我对你不客气！”阿莱格拉挥舞着白皙的小拳头，对着德克兰威胁示意。
“是是是！阿莱格拉你说如何就是如何！”德克兰讨好的笑笑，然后又笑容满面的对着文森道：“文森兄弟，刚刚多有得罪，实在抱歉！等会去奇迹酒楼，我们好好喝一杯！”
“好好好！德克兰兄弟，等会我们好好喝一杯，到时候让我们忘掉刚刚的不愉快。”文森装作高兴道，心中却暗暗警惕，这个德克兰－欧米茄虽然行事冲动，但却心机沉重，绝对不是一个好东西！
两人互相吹捧，越说越起劲，转眼间就从敌人过渡到了亲密朋友。两人的表现均落到对方眼中，彼此之间的顾忌更深，纷纷暗自决定，有机会，必须灭掉对方！

“好啦，你们两个大男人互相吹捧有意思吗？”
阿莱格拉实在看不下去了，出声阻止。“德克兰，你不是说去奇迹酒楼吗？我想吃他们家的冰雪之巅！”
德克兰讨好的走到阿莱格拉身边，献殷勤道：“好好好，我们去吃冰雪之巅！听说他们家最近推出了新口味的冰雪之巅呢！”
“啊？真的吗？”阿莱格拉两眼放光道。
德克兰得意的看了文森一眼，“去看看不就知道了？”
“好啊好啊！”阿莱格拉转身对着疾风贪狼道：“走，姐姐带你去吃好吃的！”
疾风贪狼同样双眼放光，“你，好人，可以，骑我！”
“疾风贪狼？”德克兰这时才注意到那身材高大的疾风贪狼，不过语气中多多少少有些轻蔑。
“你，是谁？”疾风贪狼看了看站在阿莱格拉身边的文森，咧着牙道：“主人，杀他？”
德克兰吓了一跳，他虽然不怎么看得起疾风贪狼，不过那玩意的确是七级魔兽啊！凭他的小身板外加四个大战师，真的不够看！
“文森兄弟！”德克兰讪笑的喊了一声。
文森瞥了一眼阿莱格拉，这两人认识，还真不好当面下杀手。于是板着脸道：“蠢货！胡说什么？等会去奇迹酒楼多吃点！”
疾风贪狼伸出猩红的舌头，舔了舔嘴唇，“对，对，多吃，多吃！”

content_en:
FS007 Imperial Prodigy
"Wait!"
Outside the crowd, four combat divisions came over here guarding a young man. The people blocking the road were knocked away by the four battle divisions.
The professional levels of warriors are similar to those of magicians. They are also divided into nine levels: Warrior Apprentice, Junior Warrior, Intermediate Warrior, Advanced Warrior, Battle Master, Epic Warrior, Legendary Warrior, Holy Spirit Warrior, and Mythical God of War.
The young man has an arrogant face, and the magic robe on his body is exquisite and elegant. The strong magic fluctuations can make people who don't understand magic feel the majesty of magic.
He held a pure white staff in his hand, which exuded strong light magic waves.
"I want this purple spar!" The young man said arrogantly, looking like he was the best in the world.
Ralph glanced at the young man in embarrassment and said, "My distinguished Lord Magician, I have sold the crystal to another distinguished Lord Magician. If you want it, why not discuss it with that Lord Magician?"
As the saying goes, when gods fight, mortals suffer. One side has a level 7 monster as a mount, and the other side has four battle masters as bodyguards. Both sides are not easy to mess with!
He, Ralph, was a junior high-level magician. He really didn't dare to offend anyone, so he could only push the problem to Vincent. After he finished speaking, he looked at Vincent pleadingly, hoping Vincent wouldn't mind.
‘Don’t involve me in the rivalry between you big shots! ’ While Ralph was praying secretly, he became confused again. It was just an amethyst heart. Although it was a treasure to little people like them, to the big people, what was the difference between it and a stone on the roadside?
Vincent smiled and said, "Pack up the stall and leave. You have nothing to do here."
"Thank you! Thank you!" Ralph put away the seventh-level magic scroll and left hurriedly with his two brothers without even putting away the other things in the stall.
"Hmph!" The arrogant young man ignored the three people's departure. He glared at Vincent fiercely, "Boy, hand over the amethyst heart!"
Vincent threw the Purple Crystal Essence away and sneered, "Are you stupid? We all know that people don't tell secrets, so why would you say this is the Purple Crystal Heart?"
The young man's face turned sideways, his eyes flashing sharply, "What do you know?"
"What do you think?" Vincent winked playfully.
"Boy, who are you?" The young man glanced at the four combat divisions, who immediately began to drive away the crowd of onlookers.
Vincent also ignored the behavior of the four war masters, "Boy, do you know that you are very rude! Before asking others, you should introduce yourself!"
"You!" The young man pointed at Vincent with his index finger and said through gritted teeth: "I, Declan Omega, Viscount of the Adri Empire, the youngest senior magician in the imperial capital, the second heir to the Omega Duke family, and a trainee priest of the Holy See of Light! So, who are you?"
The long list of names sounds quite bluffing, which is enough to show that this guy's status is indeed a second generation of sorts!
Vincent frowned slightly, then smiled self-deprecatingly, no matter how awesome this guy was, he had to get that piece of Ziling Essence!
"Vinson-Augustin doesn't have as long a list of suffixes as you do!" Vincent mocked.
"Hmph!" Declan Omega secretly went through all the major families in the empire and found that there was no big noble named Augustin. He also thought about it and thought that there was no Augustin family among the well-known big families on the mainland. He suddenly became more confident.
"Boy, let me give you a chance now. As long as you hand over the purple crystal, I will let you go!" Declan boasted coaxingly.
Vincent tossed the purple crystal again, tilted his head and glanced at him, "What if I choose not to?"
"Boy, don't be too arrogant! If you piss me off, you won't be able to see the sun tomorrow!" Declan said fiercely.
AllegraPicking up the two pieces of reddish silver ore from the stall abandoned by the three middle-aged men, he said with a smile: "Declan, you are so majestic!"
"Uh Allegra, why are you here?" Declan's momentum suddenly weakened.
Allegra raised her smooth chin and said like a proud little princess: "Why can't I be here?"
"Um haha" Declan asked in a flash: "Allegra, did you sneak out again without telling your uncle?"
"Hmph~" Allegra snorted dissatisfied: "How is that possible! I am following Mr. Mage out to play!" As she said that, Allegra pulled Vincent's magic robe pitifully.
‘This little witch! ’ Vincent sighed in his heart, and then said: “Well, Allegra and I came out to play, and the Lord of Delon knows about it.”
"Uncle knows?" Declan's expression suddenly changed, and a strong murderous intention emerged.
'snort! This boy, I will make you look good sooner or later! Oh, not only did he steal the essence of Ziling, but he also wanted to soak up Allegra? Who in the entire Yardri Empire doesn’t know that Allegra is my Declan’s fiancée! No, I’ll kill you another day! ’
Feeling this killing intent, Vincent was also secretly wary. He still didn't know the power of the family in this world. But be careful!
"Of course my father knows! By the way, Declan, Mr. Wizard is my savior. You should be polite to him! Otherwise, I will be rude to you!" Allegra waved her white little fist and threatened Declan.
"Yes, yes! Allegra, it's whatever you say!" Declan smiled flatteringly, and then said to Vincent with a smile on his face: "Brother Vincent, I'm so sorry for offending you just now! Let's go to the Miracle Restaurant later and have a drink!"
"Okay, okay! Brother Declan, let's have a drink later. Let's forget about the unpleasantness just now." Vincent pretended to be happy, but he was secretly wary in his heart. Although this Declan Omega acted impulsively, he was very scheming and was definitely not a good person!
The two complimented each other, and the more they talked, the more enthusiastic they became. In the blink of an eye, they transitioned from enemies to close friends. The performance of the two fell into the eyes of the other, and their concerns about each other became deeper. They secretly decided that if there was a chance, they must destroy the other!
"Okay, is it interesting for you two grown men to compliment each other?"
Allegra couldn't stand it anymore and stopped her. "Declan, didn't you say you were going to Miracle Restaurant? I want to eat their Ice and Snow Top!"
Declan walked up to Allegra and said courteously: "Okay, okay, let's go eat Ice and Snow Top! I heard that they have recently launched a new flavor of Ice and Snow Top!"
"Ah? Really?" Allegra said with eyes shining.
Declan glanced at Vincent proudly, "We'll know if we go and see it?"
"Okay, okay!" Allegra turned to Gale Greedy Wolf and said, "Let's go, sister will take you to eat something delicious!"
Gale Greedy Wolf's eyes also shone, "You, good man, can ride me!"
"The Gale Greedy Wolf?" Declan noticed the tall Gale Wind Greedy Wolf at this moment, but his tone was more or less contemptuous.
"Who are you?" Gale Wind Tanlang looked at Vincent standing next to Allegra, grinning and said, "Master, kill him?"
Declan was startled. Although he didn't think highly of Gale Greedy Wolf, that thing was indeed a level 7 monster! With his small body and four battle masters, it's really not enough to look at!
"Brother Vincent!" Declan shouted sarcastically.
Vincent glanced at Allegra. The two knew each other, so it was really hard to kill him in person. So he said with a straight face: "Idiot! What nonsense are you talking about? Let's go to the Miracle Restaurant to eat more later!"
Gale Greedy Wolf stuck out his scarlet tongue and licked his lips, "Yes, yes, eat more, eat more!"
